en: A black-and-white postcard showing an interior room that appears to be a museum or exhibition space. Several mannequins dressed in historical military or official uniforms are displayed against one wall, with glass-fronted wooden cabinets and a display case with drawers in the center. Portraits of formally dressed individuals hang on the wall above the uniforms. There is a doorway to another gallery in the background, where a large window and a radiator are visible. Lighting is provided by wall-mounted lamps.
